name: Tabs
summary: One row of tabs over several panels of content. The tabs are radio inputs, so the browser keeps the selection, the focus and the arrow keys without a line of script.
summaryZh: 一排标签页,下面各带一块内容。标签页就是 radio 输入框,所以选中状态、焦点和方向键都由浏览器管,不需要写一行脚本。

variants.name: Card
variants.note: The tabs sit inside a bordered strip and the selected one is filled.

states.name: Selected
states.note: The radio's own checked attribute. It is the only thing that decides which tab and which panel are open.

states.name: Stretched
states.note: The tabs fill the width they are given: every tab takes a share of it.

states.name: At the bottom
states.note: The bar of tabs sits under the panel instead of above it.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The tabs cannot be picked. The radios carry the real disabled attribute, so the browser refuses to select them, and the tabs take the derived disabled colour.

parts.name: Radio
parts.note: The real control. It is hidden by size and opacity, so it keeps its place in the tab order, and it sits inside the label of its own tab so that the browser reads one group of radios.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The row of tabs. It carries role="radiogroup", because the control under each tab is a radio and the group of radios is the group the browser reads.

parts.name: Item
parts.note: One tab. It is a <label>, so clicking it ticks the radio it holds, and it holds the radio that the keyboard reaches.

parts.name: Indicator
parts.note: The bar under the selected tab. It is drawn by the stylesheet, not an image.

parts.name: Panel
parts.note: The content of one tab. Only the panel whose radio is checked is shown, and it carries role="group" because there is no tab to own a tab panel.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the radios share. Two tab groups with different names can be open at the same time.
props.descriptionZh: 各个 radio 共用的名字。两个名字不同的标签页组可以同时处于展开状态。

props.name: type
props.description: The shape of the tab row. The line type is the base class on its own; the card type adds um-tabs--card.
props.descriptionZh: 标签栏的样式。line 就是只写基类;card 再加上 um-tabs--card。

props.name: selected
props.description: Which tab starts open. It is the checked attribute on that radio.
props.descriptionZh: 初始展开的是哪一个标签页。就是在对应的 radio 上加 checked 属性。

props.name: model-value
props.description: Which tab is open, counted from one. The binding wins over `selected`.
props.descriptionZh: 哪一个标签页是展开的,从一开始数。绑定优先于 `selected`。

props.name: stretch
props.description: Whether the tabs fill the width they are given. It adds um-tabs--stretch.
props.descriptionZh: 标签页是否撑满给定的宽度。它加上 um-tabs--stretch。

props.name: tab-position
props.description: Where the bar of tabs sits. The bar on top is the base class on its own; the bar under the panel adds um-tabs--bottom.
props.descriptionZh: 标签栏放在哪儿。在上面就是只写基类;放在面板下面再加上 um-tabs--bottom。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tabs can be picked. The radios carry the real disabled attribute, so the browser refuses to select them and the tab leaves the tab order; the class paints the disabled treatment. A single tab is disabled by putting the same attribute on its own radio in the markup.
props.descriptionZh: 标签页还能不能选。radio 上带着原生 disabled 属性,所以浏览器拒绝选中它,那个标签页也退出 Tab 顺序;类负责画出禁用态。单独一个标签页要禁用,就在标记里给它的 radio 加上同一个属性。

slots.name: panel
slots.description: The content of one tab. It goes inside the panel section.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个标签页的内容,放在面板 section 里。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The labels of the tabs, one child per tab.
slots.descriptionZh: 各个标签页的文字,一个子元素对应一个标签页。

slots.name: label
slots.description: The label of one tab. It is called once per tab with its index, the way the panel slot is.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个标签页的文字。它按标签页逐个调用,带着自己的序号,和面板插槽一样。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when another tab is picked. It is the radio group's own change event — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 切换到别的标签页时触发。这是 radio 组自己的 change 事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: The header is a radio group and the control under each tab is a radio input. The radio is the only thing in the markup that can carry the selection, and it carries it natively: the browser announces the picked tab as checked and the reader knows which one is open. That is also why the header says radiogroup and not tablist — a tablist promises tabs, and a tab has to say aria-selected, which cannot be written without JavaScript and would be stale the moment the reader picked another tab. The panels say group for the same reason: there is no tab to own a tab panel. What the reader gets is a group of radios with one of them checked, which is exactly what the widget is.
a11y.notesZh: 标签栏是一个 radio 组,每个标签页底下的控件是 radio 输入框。标记里只有 radio 能带着选中状态,而且它天生就带着:浏览器会把勾上的那一个播报为已选中,读者因此知道哪一块是展开的。这也是标签栏写 radiogroup 而不是 tablist 的原因 —— tablist 承诺的是 tab,而 tab 必须说 aria-selected,那件事没有 JavaScript 写不出来,读者一换标签它就过期了。面板写 group 也是同一个原因:已经没有 tab 可以拥有 tab panel。读者拿到的是一组 radio,其中一个勾上了,而这正是这个控件本身。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Three tabs over three panels. Each radio sits inside the label of its own tab, so the bar of tabs is one group of radios and the browser keeps exactly one of them picked. The stylesheet pairs the Nth radio with the Nth panel by position.
examples.descriptionZh: 三个标签页配三块面板。每个 radio 待在自己那个标签项的里面,所以标签栏就是一组 radio,浏览器保证只有一个是勾上的。样式表按位置把第 N 个 radio 和第 N 块面板配对。
examples.markup:
The name, the avatar and the short bio other people see.
The card on file, the invoices and the next payment date.
Notification addresses, connected accounts and the password.

examples.title: Card
examples.description: The card variant puts the tabs in a bordered strip and fills the selected one. The fill and the label colour are chosen by the variant, so the rule that matches the checked radio stays the same.
examples.descriptionZh: 卡片式把标签页放进一条带边框的栏里,选中的那一个填上底色。底色和文字颜色由变体决定,所以匹配 checked 的那条规则不用改。
examples.markup:
Three files changed in the last week.
Everything in the project, newest first.
Who touched what, and when.

examples.title: Four tabs
examples.description: Four tabs is the extent of the wiring in the stylesheet: a fifth tab needs one more selector in style.css to pair its panel — still no JavaScript.
examples.descriptionZh: 样式表里接好了四个标签页:要加第五个,只需要在 style.css 里再加一条选择器来配对它的那块面板 —— 还是不需要 JavaScript。
examples.markup:
The numbers the report is about.
Where the numbers came from.
What the numbers do not say.
What the numbers said last time.

notes: The tabs are radio inputs, and each radio sits inside the label of its own tab, so the browser sees one group of radios and holds it as a single stop in the tab order: Tab lands on the group, the arrow keys move along it, and the browser keeps exactly one radio picked. The stylesheet pairs the Nth radio with the Nth panel by position, so the panels are <section>s after the bar of tabs — `nth-of-type` has to count them apart from the <div> that holds the header. Four panels are wired out of the box; a fifth needs one more selector in this file, not a line of JavaScript. There is no add mark, no close mark and no rename field: adding a tab means writing a new radio and a new panel, closing one means taking it out of the document, and renaming one means editing a word, and none of those is something a stylesheet can do. A host that wants them brings its own controls.
notesZh: 标签页是 radio 输入框,每个 radio 待在自己那个标签项的里面,所以浏览器看到的是一组 radio,在 Tab 顺序里只占一个停靠点:Tab 落进这一组,方向键在里面移动,浏览器保证只有一个 radio 是勾上的。样式表按位置把第 N 个 radio 和第 N 块面板配对,所以面板是标签栏后面的 `<section>` —— `nth-of-type` 得把它和装标签栏的那个 `<div>` 分开数。库里接好了四块面板;要加第五块,只需要在这个文件里再加一条选择器,不用加一行 JavaScript。这里没有添加的记号、没有关闭的记号,也没有改名的输入框:加一个标签页意味着写一个新的 radio 和一块新的面板,关掉一个意味着把它从文档里拿走,改一个名字意味着编辑一个词,这些都不是样式表能做到的事。想要这些的宿主自己带控件来。
